max_depth.description: Maximum downward recursion depth; null means no limit. OVAL -1 imports as null.

file_traversal_base.description: Shared non-deprecated downward file recursion structure. Downward traversal is implicit; deprecated OVAL recurse_direction=up is not representable.

windows_file_traversal.description: Windows file traversal. Preserves the non-deprecated OVAL junction terminology rather than silently treating it as Unix symlink syntax.

object_record_field.description: One named field in an authored record-valued Object input. The field key supplies identity; match preserves OVAL field entity_check semantics.

object_record.description: Authored record-valued Object input. Record field names are structurally unique. Parent record datatype=record and operation=equals are implicit because no other native values are meaningful.

filesystem_scope.description: Filesystem search scope independent of recursion. OVAL recurse_file_system all/local/defined maps to any/local/same and applies to exact full_path as well as directory/name selection.
